## Figure 6J+K
```{r}
pdata_baseline = pdata2[pdata2$Baseline_FU_biopsy == "pre" & pdata2$Local_disease == 1, ]
data_baseline <- to_DEseq[, colnames(to_DEseq) %in% pdata_baseline$library.name]

pdata_baseline$library.name == colnames(data_baseline)
pdata_baseline$Pat_ID = paste0('pat_', pdata_baseline$Pat_ID )
library(DESeq2)

pdata_baseline[,c('Pat_ID', 'Progress_to_metastatic_disease')]
mat <- data_baseline[,-1]
#rownames(mat) <- data_baseline[,1]


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data_baseline,
                              colData = pdata_baseline,
                              design= ~ Progress_to_metastatic_disease)

table(pdata_baseline$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)
smallestGroupSize <- 10 #smallest sample number per group 33 table(pdata$CPI_ORR)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallestGroupSize
dds <- dds[keep,]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
resultsNames(dds) # lists the coefficients

res <- results(dds)

res = data.frame(res)

res = res[order(res$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]
res_2 <- rownames_to_column(res, var = "gnames")

plotd = res
plotd$Selected <- ifelse(res$padj <  0.01 ,"FDR<0.01","FDR>0.01")
plotd$ml10pv = -log(plotd$padj)
rownames(plotd) <- res_2$gnames

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

selected_genes_up <- subset(plotd, log2FoldChange > 1 & padj < 0.05)
selected_genes_down <- subset(plotd, log2FoldChange < -1 & padj < 0.05)

Volcano_DM_v_noDM <- EnhancedVolcano(plotd,
                lab = rownames(plotd),
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'pvalue',
                selectLab = c("TBRG1", "IFNAR2", "IRF1-AS1", "XBP1", "CD300A", "DERL3", "CD79A", "MZB1", "IGKC", "IGHG4", "CD8A", "IL10RA", 
                              "DLK1", "DSP", "S100A8", "KRT9", "STOX1", "KLF4", "MAFF", "DNMT3B", "PSRC1", "MOB3B", "B2M", "CD274"),
                xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ 'fold change (DM vs no dist. Met.)'),
                ylab = bquote(~-Log[10]~ 'P (adjusted)'),
                axisLabSize = 18,
                ylim = c(0, 8),
                pCutoff = 10e-2,
                FCcutoff = 1.0,
                pointSize = 2.0,
                labSize = 4.0,
                labCol = 'black',
                labFace = 'bold',
                boxedLabels = TRUE,
                colAlpha = 4/5,
                legendPosition = 'top',
                legendLabels = c("FDR>0.05", expression(Log[2] ~ FC >1), "FDR<0.01", expression(FDR <0.01 ~ and
                                                                                      ~ log[2] ~ FC>1)),
                col = c('grey', 'royalblue','orange', 'red'),
                legendLabSize = 14,
                legendIconSize = 4.0,
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                widthConnectors = 1.0,
                colConnectors = 'black')

Volcano_DM_v_noDM
output_dir <- "/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/output/DM_v_noDM/"
ggsave(plot = Volcano_DM_v_noDM, filename = paste0(output_dir, "DM_v_noDM_Volcanoplot.pdf"), height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)
```

## Figure 6K: PCA scores for DM vs no distant metastasis
```{r}
pdata = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_pdata_MCC.csv")
data = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_counts_MCC.csv", row.names = 1)

pdata$library.name == colnames(data)

pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease <- ifelse(pdata$Baseline_FU_biopsy != "pre" | pdata$Local_disease != 1, NA, pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)

data2 = data[,!(is.na(pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease))]
pdata2 = pdata[!(is.na(pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)),]

pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease

phenotypes = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/scripts/LCMseq_analysis/Phenotypes_scores_list.csv",header = T)
phenotypes[phenotypes == ""] = NA 
phenotypes = as.list(phenotypes, na.rm = T)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, na.omit)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, toupper)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

my_comparisons <- list( c("0", "1"))

res = data.frame(patient = pdata2$Pat_ID, type = pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)

## Boxplots corrected for multiple hypothesis testing
for(element in names(phenotypes)){
  to_PCA = data2[rownames(data2) %in% phenotypes[[element]],]
  to_PCA = log2(t(to_PCA+1))
  PCA = prcomp(to_PCA,scale. = T)
  coeff[[element]] = PCA$rotation
  res[[element]] = PCA$x[,1]
  
  to_plot = data.frame(type = pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease,
                       PC1_scores = PCA$x[,1])
  
  to_plot$type = factor(to_plot$type)

  stat.test <- to_plot %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste0("PC1_scores", " ~ ", "type"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = )

# Print the results of the statistical test
  stat.test
  
  colors <- c("white", "black")
  
# Create a box plot with jittered points for each column in "cols"
  to_plot %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(x = type, y = PC1_scores, fill = "type") +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", linetype = 1, width = 0.03, lwd = 0.7, color = "#333333") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = colors, width = 0.4, lwd = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 1.6, position = position_jitter(w = 0.18, h = 0), shape = 21, stroke = 1.0) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 10)+
    labs(y = paste0(element, " percentage"), title = element) +
    xlab("Distant.metastasis")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("no", "yes")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test,
                       label = "p.adj",
                       label.size = 5,
                       fontface = "italic",
                       bracket.size = 1)
  ggsave(paste0('PCA_score_',element,'.pdf'), width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
